description: Literal one-hour scoring rules for the Zenodo Texas dispatch game. The price/value profile is a reproducible instructional diurnal profile repeated across the selected half-year; it is not a claim of an hourly ERCOT market forecast.

vector_generation.note: The repeated profile is a teaching assumption pending an approved hourly market-price series.

storage_cost_provenance.currency_year: 2022 USD for capital benchmarks; nominal instructional coefficients
storage_cost_provenance.basis: rounded teaching split calibrated to EIA and NREL utility-scale battery benchmarks
storage_cost_provenance.evaluator_mapping: The current evaluator charges storage operation per discharged MWh; fixed O&M is retained as a reference rather than double-counted.

energy_price_provenance.market_anchor: ERCOT Day-Ahead Market HB_HUBAVG representative observations
